Hydrogen ions (H⁺) form when an acid releases a proton, which happens when the acid ionizes in water (for example, HCl → H⁺ + Cl⁻, with the H⁺ then present as H₃O⁺). The team note about anaerobic glycolysis describes a physiological source of acid, not the general answer to this question. Since the question gives no options, I'm keeping the standard chemistry answer.
